title: Dedicated SKU rollout orchestration and release-notes sync for new instance tiers
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Goal: coordinate the public launch and internal rollout of three new dedicated instance SKUs (L2/L3 quantized variants) across Singapore and Tokyo regions, plus flexible reservation tiers. Deliverables: consolidated release notes, customer-facing pricing table, support runbook, docs updates, marketing brief, and post-launch telemetry dashboards.

Scope details:
- SKU definitions: L2-8q (8-bit quantized, low-memory), L3-16q (higher throughput), and L3-burst (burst capacity profile). Confirm binary compatibility and API compatibility matrix with Serving/Runtime teams.
- Reservations: introduce Flexible-Quarterly and Flex-Commit tiers; map existing reservation converter to new pricing and show examples in docs.
- Regions: SG (ap-southeast-1) and JP (ap-northeast-1) initial rollout with plan to mirror roles in EU/US in later waves.

Cross-team coordination required:
- Engineering (Runtime & Infra): capacity readiness checklist, compatibility sign-off, API versioning notes, canary plan, rollback triggers. Owner: Michael Chen (assignee).
- Design: pricing table UX and Console rollout banner copy. Owner: Lena Park (DES-402).
- Docs: release notes, migration guide, reservation conversion examples. Owner: Aaron Li (docs lead).
- Support & CS: support playbook, escalation paths, sample customer migration scripts. Owner: Maria Alvarez (Support).
- Finance/GT M: final SKU pricing, billing validation, marketplace listings. Owner: Tom Richardson (Finance).

Release-notes & comms plan:
1) Draft release notes (internal) with technical details and known limitations - target 2026-03-20.
2) External release notes (customer-friendly) and migration FAQ - target 2026-03-24.
3) Console banner + in-product link to docs on launch day.
4) Email + blog post coordinated with marketing; embargoed assets to Sales on 2026-03-25.

Staging and rollout phases:
- Phase A (internal canary): 2 weeks in staging with 5 internal tenants; monitor latency, tail-latency, error-rate.
- Phase B (gradual public canary): route 5% of eligible traffic for 48h with automated rollback on SLO breach.
- Phase C (general availability): open SKUs & reservations for all orgs in the regions.

Monitoring & SLA checks:
- Dashboards: per-SKU latency, p50/p95/p99, token-cost delta vs baseline, reservation utilization.
- Alerting: automated incident runbook if p99 increases >20% for 30m or error-rate >1%.

Rollback & contingency:
- Immediate fallback to previous SKU families with compatible kernel selection.
- Inventory of customer reservations to prevent accidental double-billing during migration.

Open decisions / trade-offs:
- Whether to expose L3-burst as preemptible only (cheaper but less predictable) vs guaranteed with higher price. Engineering prefers preemptible for capacity efficiency; Sales prefers guaranteed for enterprise customers. Decision due 2026-03-10 (action: PM to finalize).
- Reservation conversion rounding rules (finance prefers floor, customers prefer prorate). Needs legal/finance sign-off.

Required artifacts and owners:
- Draft release notes (Confluence): owner Aaron Li -> link placeholder.
- Pricing spreadsheet (Sheets): owner Tom Richardson -> link placeholder.
- Support playbook (Drive): owner Maria Alvarez -> link placeholder.
- Migration scripts (GitHub): owner ENG-2841 -> PR placeholder.

Expected risks and mitigations:
- Risk: unexpected latency regression at high seq-length. Mitigation: hold GA until runtime team closes optimization ticket ENG-2917 and run additional stress tests.
- Risk: billing edge-cases for reservation conversions. Mitigation: Finance-run simulation against top 50 customers and staged rollouts.

Success metrics:
- GA launch with <5% active customer migration issues in first 14 days.
- Reservation conversion accuracy >99.5% across simulation scenarios.
- No p99 latency regression >10% compared to baseline on GA traffic.

Next steps (week of 2026-03-14):
- PM to finalize public release notes draft and circulate to stakeholders (due 2026-03-17).
- Engineering to provide canary configuration and test plan (due 2026-03-16).
- Design to deliver pricing table mockups (due 2026-03-15).
